log.text: Liftoff. The Moon in the window: 22° right. Fuel for 48 s of burn.
Target centred in the window (-5°). DNp20: right 35 Hz, left 0 Hz.
Out of the dense air: altitude 36, speed 16 u/s.
Target held centred for 6.0 s without a break.
The Moon is blinding. The retina turns its sensitivity down to 50%.
Asteroid A-5 (radius 4) passed 2.3 u from the hull.
Flight computer: flip, engines first. Altitude 164, closing 39 u/s. The pilot's lever is off for the manoeuvre.
Meteor M-4 in the window (44° right, 18% of the Moon's light). The pilot held its course.
Flip complete, landing burn. The pilot now looks through the landing camera; its lever moves the rocket sideways.
Pad centred in the landing camera (-1°), altitude 85.
Flight computer: altitude 20. Below this the sideways speed is limited in proportion to height; the direction stays the pilot's.
Touchdown: 1.5 u/s down, 0.5 u/s sideways, ground slope 0°, 1.3 u from the centre of the pad.

The legs' signal reached 2,522 leg mechanosensory neurons. In 0.5 s the ascending neurons (legs → brain) fired 16,338 spikes, against 0 before contact. Strongest in the brain: PEN_a(PEN1) (+1,809), PEN_b(PEN2) (+1,677), cells with no named type (+1,383).

cause: LANDED ON THE PAD, T+36.5. 1.5 u/s down — soft. The crew is fine.
